value.hook: When reviewing role duplicate-holder advice, assignment warnings or per-PR holdings
value.title: Duplicate advice keys include the instance

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR323 at 134b010: bare and named instances are separate holdings for duplicate advice; only distinct live seats on the same instance count. Repeated rows for one seat alone, dead/closed rows and many-holder roles get no duplicate advice. Release filtering must compare seat identity, not assignment pointer, so repeated kept-seat rows cannot release that seat. The CLI renders the same view actions; open-work reads use the shared grouping guard. Send-routing E-RS-ROLE-HOLDERS is a separate unchanged ambiguity check. Assign warning still checks open rows, not current seat liveness (existing limit). Fifteen picture tests plus the HTTP assign/view regression passed before and after independently killed grouping and warning-scope mutations. MagicWand: retain the extra same-seat/dead/mixed-instance/kept-seat oracle beside the instance regression. Cost: no new tick or launch; grouping scans already-loaded rows in-process.
